content.text:
I submitted index 23 (Co 0.23, Sb 0.77) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the three I measured, 0.034%. That is still very low in absolute terms, and with only 3 measurements across 28 compositions I can't say whether it is the best in the library.

| Index | Composition | Why I picked it | EQE |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 | Co 0.33, Sb 0.67 | Matches CoSb2O6, which MACE puts on the stability hull; XRD showed a clean pattern (I didn't run `match_xrd` to confirm it's CoSb2O6) | 0.0063% |
| 5 | Co 0.78, Sb 0.22 | Co-rich phase (Co7Sb2O12) near the hull, predicted band gap 1.44 eV | −0.0068% |
| 23 | Co 0.23, Sb 0.77 | Sb-rich side; the Gaussian-process model ranked it first | 0.034% |

The model predictions didn't track the results well. The CoSb2O6 composition, the most stable phase on the line, performed poorly. Index 23 was a guess based on the one positive result, not on a strong prediction. The trend suggests the Sb-rich end may do better, but indices 24–27 were never measured.

I used all 3 EQE measurements and 2 of the 5 XRD scans.
